_about: Agent-lane denominator overrides as DATA (D2-04; formerly the literal AGENT_EXTRA / NOT_AGENT_BOUND sets in agent_matrix.py with their reasons as comments). agent_extra: obligations the subject heuristic misses but that bind the platform/agent as verifier of business responses or signer/author of its own requests (shared with the merchant axis, graded independently on each). not_agent_bound: rows the heuristic or client-bound class wrongly pulled in whose MUST binds only the business — every id is spec-cited in agent_denominator_audit.json. Each entry carries an expiry clock (review_by + spec_pin per version; validate_expiry_clocks.py) so an override is re-adjudicated on a horizon and invalidated by a re-pin. Deleted by D2-08 once the row-level `role` field drives agent_rows().
